title: MCP Guard local-issuer receipt, signed payload (receiptVersion 2, jcs_v2)
description: The decoded signed payload of a receipt issued by MCP Guard (permission-protocol/mcp-guard 0.3.0 and later), a local issuer (SPEC.md section 14). Same canonicalization, digest and signature as schema/receipt-v2.json describes; a different value profile: no companyId (no tenant), an MCP request shape, the local deciders and the mcpg- key ids. Fields whose value is null are absent, never present as null.

idemKey.description: mcp-guard:<decision id>: the held call's queue id, else a fresh UUID.

agentId.description: --agent-id of the guard run; github-webhook for a pull request queued by the webhook.

requestJson.description: Canonical JSON text of {action:{operation,resource,tool?},context:{mode,reversibility?,transport},hashes:{inputHash},intent:{category:"mcp_tool_call",name:"mcp_guard_decision"},policy:{decision:{outcome,ruleId?,ruleVersion}},scope?:{capability,ref?,commitSha?}}. Never carries tool arguments; resource is the configured server label, never the server's command line.

inputHash.description: pp.hashable_payload.v1 over {tool, operation, input, metadata: null}: tool is the tool name (the method for a non-tool method), operation the JSON-RPC method (github/merge for a webhook pull request), input the arguments the server receives with agent metadata (_pp) removed.

status.description: The decision. Only decisions are signed; pending holds, EXPIRED and ERROR rows carry no signature and are not receipts under this specification.

riskTier.description: mcp-guard's own tier from the tool and argument names. Not the hosted service's A_READONLY..D_PROHIBITED.

policyVersion.description: SHA-256 of the loaded configuration file's bytes.

reasonCodes.description: JSON array text from a fixed set: RULE_MATCHED:<rule id> or DEFAULT_ACTION first, then COUNTDOWN_AUTO_RELEASE, OPERATOR_APPROVED, OPERATOR_DENIED or APPROVAL_EXPIRED when a hold was resolved.

summary.description: MCP Guard approved|denied "<tool>" by <decider display>. No argument values.

signatureKeyId.description: Self-certifying: the first 16 hex digits of SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte public key. A verifier recomputes it from the key and refuses a mismatch.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds (Date.prototype.toISOString). Expiry bounds one-time redemption of an approval; the signature stays valid evidence after expiry.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds. The moment the receipt row was created; for decision receipts signed at decision time this is when the decision landed.

deciderId.description: system/mcp-guard-policy: a rule, a spend cap, a countdown or an expiry decided; no person. local:<operator>: the operator named by --operator (default the OS user) in the local console. Absent only on an unattributed console denial.

deciderAuthMethod.description: local_console: a decision in the guard's loopback console, which requires a per-process token printed to the operator's terminal.

attributionConfidence.description: credentialed: a named policy version (system/mcp-guard-policy). heuristic: a console decision; the token proves access to the guard's terminal, the name is configured, not authenticated. unattributed: a console denial with no operator (an unattributed approval is refused in production).

scope.description: demo exactly when the signing key is an mcpg-demo- key.
